periodLab: Lab jobs relevant to selected period
deductUnpaidToday: Period ends today: deduct unpaid portions only. Paid portions are shown for reference, not deducted.
deductPaidPeriod: Historical period: deduct only portions paid within the inclusive selected dates.
reviewGroup: Incomplete / review required — not automatically deducted
reviewWarning: {{count}} portions need review; shown separately without automatic deduction.
sameDayOnly: Payments can only be reversed on the Bangkok day they were marked paid. Locked after that day.
chargesLessOutstanding: Treatment charges less outstanding (not period profit)
unknownDates: {{count}} portions excluded: assignment or payment date is unknown.
historyLimit: Includes older unpaid assignments. Later reversals, cost edits, or dentist changes can alter historical results; this is not an immutable accounting ledger.
reverseWarning: Reverse this payment? Its payment date will be cleared and historical reports may change. This action is recorded in the audit log.
reverseBeforeEdit: Reverse the affected payment before editing.
companyLoadError: Unable to load lab companies. Please reload.
companyAndTypeRequired: Select a type and lab company for every lab job.
payAllDescription: Marks every outstanding lab cost as paid — for every entry system-wide with a known amount and an assigned dentist, not limited to the filters currently shown on this page. This takes effect immediately for all dentists.
